messages.text: I started taking ramipril yesterday, dear. All fine with the tablets.
Mum's got that tickly dry cough, started this morning 😕
I've been off ramipril for five days. Haven't touched it.
Mum's cough disappeared two days ago. She's so relieved!
I've been taking ramipril again since Monday. Hoping for the best.
Oh no, mum's dry cough has been back since yesterday 😩
